changes.title: Pope Leo returns to sanctuary where he prayed after election and unveils a fresco depicting the event
changes.summary: Pope Leo XIV returned Monday to a sanctuary where he prayed just after his election and revealed a permanent sign of his devotion to the place: a fresco depicting him praying that now adorns an upper cornice of the basilica.
